sentences.text:
1  THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S 482 CR.PC (FILED U/S 528 BNNS)
 PRAYING TO DIRECT THE IV ADDL.CHIEF JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE AT  BENGALURU, TO EXPEDITE THE PROCEEDINGS IN CC.NO.751/2016  ARISING OUT OF THE CRIME NO.215/2010 FOR THE OFFENCES  PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTION 409, 420, 506 OF IPC, 1860 AND SECTION  18 OF PAWN BROKERS ACT, 1961 AS EXPEDITIOUSLY AS POSSIBLE  -2-  NC: 2025:KHC:19093  CRL.P No. 5903 of 2025  HC-KAR WITHIN A TIME LIMIT THIS HONBLE COURT DEEMS FIT IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM:

ORAL ORDER Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned HCGP for the respondent and perused the material on record.
2.

The limited prayer of the petitioner - de facto complainant in the present petition is for a direction to the Trial Court to dispose of C.C.No.751/2016 arising out of Crime No.215/2010 registered by the respondent - police for offences punishable under Sections 409, 420 and 506 IPC within a stipulated timeframe.

3. In view of the fact that the aforesaid proceedings in C.C.No.751/2016 is pending for the last nine years before the IV ACJM, Bangalore, without expressing any opinion on merits / demerits of the rival contentions, I deem it just and appropriate to direct the Trial Court to dispose of the aforesaid suit as NC: 2025:KHC:19093 HC-KAR expeditiously as possible and preferably within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
4. With the aforesaid directions, the petition stands disposed of.

Sd/-
(S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR) JUDGE Srl.
